question: Should this maintainer-requested, cross-cutting transcript-storage refactor merge after the remaining real-runtime proof and current check results are reviewed, or should it be split into narrower changes?
rationale: The PR changes persisted session identity and Plugin SDK compatibility across hundreds of files, so deciding whether its current scope is acceptable requires owner judgment beyond a mechanical repair.

options.title: Review and land as one refactor
options.body: Accept the one-path SQLite ownership design after reviewing redacted runtime proof, upgrade behavior, and the final exact-head check results.

options.title: Split compatibility-sensitive surfaces
options.body: Land the core runtime deletion separately from remaining Plugin SDK, channel, trajectory, or migration compatibility changes if review cannot establish one cohesive upgrade boundary.

recommendation.title: Review and land as one refactor
recommendation.body: Accept the one-path SQLite ownership design after reviewing redacted runtime proof, upgrade behavior, and the final exact-head check results.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows sustained ownership of the proposed session-runtime design and its compatibility follow-ups.
